title: Vídeo publicitario disruptivo — Legadia
prompt:
Create a disruptive, high-budget, 10-second outdoor advertising film for a premium Spanish inheritance investigation company.

A crowded glass bus shelter located beside Madrid-Barajas Airport, with aircraft and terminal architecture visible in the background. Travellers carrying suitcases move quickly past the shelter while the camera performs a fast cinematic lateral tracking shot.

Inside the bus shelter, a large vertical digital billboard displays a confident Spanish man approximately 55 years old wearing an elegant dark-blue jacket.

The man inside the advertisement suddenly comes alive. He turns his head, looks directly through the screen and establishes eye contact with one specific Spanish passerby approximately 50 years old. He leans forward and points directly at him while speaking in Spanish.

The digital screen bends dramatically outward with a spectacular anamorphic 3D advertising effect. Old family photographs, inheritance documents, sealed envelopes and glowing golden genealogical lines violently burst out of the billboard into the real world.

Use a brief dramatic slow-motion moment as the photographs, documents and golden lines remain suspended in the air. One golden line rapidly travels through the crowd and connects directly with the selected man.

At that exact moment, everyone else freezes. The selected man stops, looks around and reacts with genuine astonishment as he realizes that the advertisement is addressing him personally.

The billboard man continues pointing directly at him. Finish with a powerful cinematic push-in toward the selected man’s astonished face and then return to the illuminated billboard.

The final billboard must display this exact Spanish message:

"USTED AÚN NO LO SABE,
PERO LE ESTAMOS BUSCANDO.
PUEDE TENER PARTE DE UNA HERENCIA."

Final button text:

"DESCUBRA SU CASO AHORA"

AUDIO:
Enable sound. Begin with authentic Madrid airport ambience: distant aircraft, rolling suitcases, footsteps, subdued terminal announcements and natural crowd noise.

When the billboard man comes alive, add a deep cinematic impact. During the anamorphic explosion, use powerful controlled whooshes, digital screen tension, glass vibration, flying paper sounds and a rising cinematic effect.

Create a brief dramatic silence when the golden line connects with the selected man. Finish with a powerful but elegant advertising sound impact.

VOICE:
Use a native male voice from Madrid, Spain, approximately 50 to 55 years old. Standard Castilian Spanish with a natural Madrid accent. Deep, confident, direct and slightly unsettling, but never aggressive, theatrical or caricatured.

The billboard man must say this exact sentence:

"Usted aún no lo sabe, pero le estamos buscando porque puede tener parte de una herencia. Descubra su caso ahora."

Synchronize the billboard man’s lips precisely with the Spanish voice. Do not translate, shorten, rewrite or alter the sentence.

VISUAL STYLE:
Premium international advertising campaign, bold direct-response storytelling, photorealistic Spanish people, spectacular controlled visual effects, strong cinematic contrast, electric blue and warm gold colour palette, realistic Madrid airport environment, emotionally provocative and impossible to ignore.
negative_prompt: No office, no lawyers, no meetings, no conventional corporate imagery, no fantasy atmosphere, no horror, no comedy, no English voice, no Latin American accent, no robotic voice, no incorrect Spanish text, no distorted faces, no duplicated people, no deformed hands, no extra dialogue, no camera shake and no logos.

audio.spoken_text: Usted aún no lo sabe, pero le estamos buscando porque puede tener parte de una herencia. Descubra su caso ahora.

onscreen_text: PUEDE TENER PARTE DE UNA HERENCIA.
